endorsements.quote: We need to measure task performance and user experience in the real world, not in simulated environments.

unlisted_practices: Measure user experience of healthcare professionals interacting with AI in real-world clinical settings using a multimethod toolkit combining ecological momentary assessment, quantitative observations, and baseline psychophysiological measurements.
Conduct human-centered evaluative research alongside prospective model accuracy evaluations.
Develop AI decision-support tools in a manner that avoids automation bias, complacency bias, and deskilling.
Develop specific standards and guidance for the safety and user experience of AI-enabled decision-support tools, including those based on large language models.
Embed brief validated user experience assessment items directly within the AI system to minimize workflow disruption.
Provide clinicians with thorough information on the purpose, data privacy management, and implementation of user experience data collection toolkits.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/framework paper proposing a multimodal toolkit/framework to evaluate human-AI interaction in real-world healthcare settings rather than presenting original empirical data.
